limits: Approval is only of the four observed in-memory public checkpoint capacity cases at 200,000/80,000 free bytes, with zero or one actual previous pure result. These are measurement targets, not a complete TR08 or SPEC0224 acceptance bar.

No >50 observation exhaustion, multiple tools, exact transition threshold, worst-case 32,768-byte body output/envelope, every metadata/complexity combination, delivered cursor >0, or arbitrary mandatory-result set was tested. Actual body outputs here are 29 bytes; the native prospective guard uses its own large placeholder.

Rules short-circuit model calls: no model request delivery, counter qualification, model admission/reservation/settlement, nonzero token/cost/model spend or real provider proof. Native maxTokens/maxCost/model/rules settings and 30,000ms runtime duration budget remain unchanged; frozen test timeout remains 60,000ms.

No PostgreSQL, container, native PG codec, process restart, concurrency, fence, provider, network service, real data, SDK/host integration, broader regression, lint/typecheck/certify/SBOM/license gate or full goal/program acceptance was executed by this critic.
Native PG NUL is required functionalFAIL outside this proof, per the user and sealed contract. It was not rerun, repaired, waived or converted to pass. No SPEC0225 implementation occurred.

Refusal permits checkpoint IDs/digests, terminal stop, acceptedDecision and activeDurationMs to change; byte-identical whole checkpoints are not claimed. Journal post-resume equality is asserted by the frozen test but its reread is not separately present as a raw trace field.

Sentinel scope is explicit packet/live bindings and indexed transitive files, not a full forbidden-state or whole-workspace inventory. .agent/.gauntlet/history/ledgers were deliberately not read. No workspace, repository-source, lock/install/checker, git, commit/push/deploy or governance-document mutation was performed.

The upstream candidate-manifest file was not separately supplied/read; candidate identity is the user-given 090ebc... label bound by this hash-verified sealed packet. All 70 concrete source bindings were verified directly.
